description: Source code for Google Text Moderation class using Google Cloud Natural Language API, integrated with FastAPI and custom logging, for content safety moderation.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_GoogleTextModeration
classes.description: Class for moderating text content using Google Cloud Natural Language API, with configurable confidence thresholds and logging.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the moderation client, loads Google Cloud language library, sets confidence thresholds for categories.

methods.name: print_verbose
methods.description: Logs verbose debug messages and optionally prints them if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: Asynchronously processes messages, calls Google API for moderation, and raises exception if content violates safety thresholds.
